units.source_text: 吴清源六段住在富士见的高原疗养所里。

en.t: Go Seigen, sixth dan, was staying at the highland sanatorium in Fujimi.

units.source_text: 每次在箱根对局，砂田记者都到富士见去取解说的口述笔记。

en.t: Whenever there was a match in Hakone, the reporter Sunada would go to Fujimi to collect the dictated notes for the commentary.

units.source_text: 我把这些笔记适当地插入观战记里。

en.t: I inserted these notes where appropriate into the game report.

units.source_text: 报社选中他担任解说，是因为他同大竹七段是年轻棋手的双璧，实力和名望都是旗鼓相当，出类拔萃。

en.t: The newspaper chose him to serve as commentator because he and Otake, seventh dan, were the two finest young players, evenly matched in both strength and reputation, and stood out above the rest.
